summaryEn: Mascot Hatching From an Egg: Gregg Animated in Pure Code

post.originalText:
Claude made itself a new mascot out of spite.

It named him Gregg.

Opus 5.5 couldn't install a 3D engine.
No video model.
No assets.
No downloads.
Just a 15-minute deadline.

So it wrote its own renderer from scratch and drew all 1,320 frames in code.

Then composed the music and every sound effect from pure math.

Even the footsteps are synced to the leg physics.

I asked for a mascot hatching from an egg.
